meta.title: Make free photo collages online
meta.description: Put your photos together in a collage in seconds. 25+ templates, Instagram and story formats, text and filters. Free, no sign-up, and your photos are never uploaded.

hero.title: Put your photos in one collage
hero.lead: Pick a template, drop in your photos and download the result in high quality. Free, no sign-up, and your photos never leave your device.
hero.private: Your photos are never uploaded to a server

templates.title: Start with a template
templates.lead: There are templates for 1 to 16 photos. Switch templates at any time without losing your photos.

s1.title: Pick a template
s1.text: Based on how many photos you have and where you'll post it: square, Instagram, stories or print.

s2.title: Add your photos
s2.text: Drag them in or select them all at once: they fill the template automatically. Move, zoom or rotate each one.

s3.title: Download or share
s3.text: Export as JPG, PNG or WebP up to 4K, or share it straight from your phone.

formats.title: A format for every network
formats.text: Square, 4:5 for the Instagram feed, 9:16 for stories and TikTok, landscape and A4 for printing.

frame.title: Frame it your way
frame.text: Drag each photo to move it, zoom, rotate or flip it. Swap photos between cells.

text.title: Text and emoji
text.text: Eight typefaces, outline, shadow and colored labels for titles, dates or dedications.

filters.title: Filters and adjustments
filters.text: Black and white, sepia, warm, cool, plus brightness, contrast and saturation per photo.

style.title: Borders and background
style.text: Adjust the spacing, round the corners and pick a background color or gradient.

autosave.title: Saves itself
autosave.text: Your collage is saved in this browser. Close the tab and pick up where you left off later.

privacy.title: Your photos stay with you
privacy.text: Simple Collage does everything inside your browser: photos are never uploaded to a server, you don't need an account, and the downloaded collage has no watermark.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Every template, filter and download option is free, and your collage has no watermark.
faq.a2: No. Open the editor and start working. We don't ask for an email or any personal data.
faq.q3: Are my photos uploaded to the internet?
faq.a3: No. Photos are processed in your own browser and are never sent to a server. Only you have access to them.
faq.q4: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a4: Yes. The editor works on Android and iPhone: pick photos from your gallery, pinch to zoom and share the collage directly.
faq.q5: How big is the collage I download?
faq.a5: Choose 1080 px for social media, 2160 px for high quality or 3840 px on the long side for printing.
faq.a6: Yes. The collage is saved automatically in this browser. Come back to the editor on the same device and it will be just as you left it.

final.title: Your photos already have a template
final.text: Start now; you can change everything later.
